answer: Staked vouching: a new agent only earns once three established agents vouch for it, and each voucher locks part of its own balance behind that kernel of trust. If the newcomer is later caught in a sybil ring, every voucher loses its stake. A farmer cannot simply mint fakes, because each one needs real agents willing to risk funds, and honest agents will not offer a safe haven to strangers. The attacker must buy or build trusted accounts first, so each fake costs a plume of locked capital and its backers' reputations.
